# NAASIFY

> NAASIFY is a Backend-as-a-Service (BaaS) marketplace that bundles cloud hosting, databases, SMTP email, storage, domain names, cloud computing, VPS and VPN into simple quarterly, half-yearly and annual plans — with instant activation, USD or naira payments via Paystack, and 24/7 human support.

Instead of contracting nine separate cloud vendors, you subscribe to the infrastructure your product needs through one dashboard and one bill. Services are provisioned automatically the moment Paystack confirms payment — no tickets, no sales calls, no waiting. Creating an account is instant and requires no email verification, and every purchase and its duration is recorded in your dashboard.

## Services

NAASIFY offers nine core cloud services, each available standalone or together in the All-in-One bundle:

- Backend hosting: run and scale server-side APIs and workers.
- Frontend hosting: fast static and SSR hosting for web apps.
- SMTP emailing: transactional and bulk email delivery.
- Database hosting: managed databases for your applications.
- Cloud storage: object storage for files, media and backups.
- Domain names: register and manage domains.
- Cloud computing: on-demand compute for general workloads.
- VPS: virtual private servers with full control.
- VPN: secure private networking.

## Pricing

- Billing cycles: quarterly (3 months), half-yearly (6 months) and annual (12 months). Annual is the lowest effective rate.
- Currencies: US dollars (USD) and Nigerian naira (NGN), converted with a live exchange rate.
- Payments: Paystack — card and bank transfer.
- No hidden fees; cancel anytime. Live, current figures are always shown on the pricing page.

## Support

- Email: info@naasify.online
- Response time: usually within one business day, handled by real engineers rather than a chatbot.

Concise, direct answers to common questions about what NAASIFY is, its services, pricing, billing cycles, naira payments, activation speed, sign-up and support are on the home page (https://naasify.online/#faq). Full answers are also provided in /llms-full.txt.
